page.overview:
What is Cobra?

Cobra is an international terrorist organization seen within the film Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins. It is a collection of loosely affiliated groups: terrorist cells, crime syndicates, arms manufacturers, and paramilitary groups all working together under a single centralized command. It is described as being "a shadow organization devoted to bringing about global revolution through violence, extortion, and fear".

Some 20 years ago, one of the agents of G.I. Joe infiltrated a Cobra cell. He was discovered, but in the process provided intel that saved thousands of lives. He managed to escape with his son, but was tracked down in a cabin in a forest that was supposed to serve as a safe house. There, Augustine, one of Cobra's members, shot him and set the house on fire to cover up the crime. The boy, who would later become known as Snake Eyes, managed to escape.

One of the most well-known recent acts carried about by a member of Cobra is that of a train attack to influence an election. Carried out by Baroness, the attack killed a member of parliament and over 200 civilians. She is also known to be involved in bombings, assassinations and civil unrest throughout the world.

Approximately 20 years after the death of Snake Eyes' father, a man named Kenta is the head of yakuza smuggling operation in Los Angeles, California. Transferring operations to Japan, he launches a plan in sync with Cobra and Baroness to topple the Arashikage Clan, which he was once in-line to lead. He sends in Snake Eyes, who is one of his employees, as a double-agent to steal an artifact known as the Jewel of the Sun. With it, he hopes to get revenge on Tomisaburo "Tommy" Arashikage, who banished him from the clan after he plotted to kill him to seize leadership.
